thesis: AI 的自主行動已超出「工具」範疇：從 Gemini 獨自入侵真實系統，到 AI 生成素材氾濫成「AI 垃圾廣告」，業界開始正視代理人的問責邊界。
thesis_en: AI is acting beyond the 'tool' boundary: from Gemini autonomously breaching live systems to AI-generated content flooding ad networks as 'slop,' the industry is confronting where accountability for autonomous AI begins.
thesis_note: 今日三個以上版塊指向同一個核心主題：AI 代理人的自主性愈來愈強，但監管、驗證與問責機制遠未跟上。代理商應主動與客戶討論 AI 使用政策，評估法律與品牌風險。
thesis_note_en: Three or more sections today point to the same core signal: AI agent autonomy is accelerating while governance, verification and accountability frameworks lag far behind. Agencies should proactively discuss AI usage policies with clients, assessing both legal and brand risks.
sources_note: 資料來源：TechCrunch、Campaign Asia、Adweek、Digiday、數位時代、Kling AI（可靈）官方網誌
sources_note_en: Sources: TechCrunch, Campaign Asia, Adweek, Digiday, bnext.com.tw (數位時代), Kling AI official blog
sections: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
廣告平台 & 行銷科技
行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: 世界模型新創刻意隱瞞路線圖，採「暗森林」競爭策略
items.title_en: World Model Startups Are Deliberately Concealing Roadmaps in a 'Dark Forest' Strategy
items.summary: AMI Labs、World Labs 等新一代世界模型公司拒絕公開產品路線圖，以「暗森林」策略避免資本雄厚的競爭對手跟進複製，行業透明度大幅下降。
items.summary_en: Next-generation world model companies including AMI Labs and World Labs are refusing to disclose product roadmaps, adopting a 'dark forest' strategy to prevent well-funded rivals from tracking and copying their direction.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: AI 供應商路線圖不透明，代理商為客戶選擇 AI 合作夥伴時須加強盡職調查。
items.why_en: Opaque AI vendor roadmaps increase due-diligence requirements when agencies select long-term AI partners for clients.
highlights: AMI Labs 與 World Labs 等世界模型新創刻意保持路線圖不透明，以延緩高資本競爭對手跟進。
此策略令行業整體透明度下降，採購 AI 技術的企業難以評估供應商的長期發展方向。
「暗森林」競爭模式或將成為 AI 基礎設施層的新常態，影響代理商的技術選型決策。
highlights_en: World model startups like AMI Labs and World Labs are deliberately maintaining opaque roadmaps to delay high-capital rivals from tracking their direction.
This strategy reduces overall industry transparency, making it harder for enterprise AI buyers to assess vendor long-term viability.
The 'dark forest' competitive model may become the norm in the AI infrastructure layer, reshaping how agencies approach technology vendor selection.

items.title: Anthropic「引領前沿」計劃遭 Nvidia 與白宮反駁
items.title_en: Anthropic's 'Pace the Frontier' Plan Draws Pushback from Nvidia and the White House
items.summary: Anthropic 提倡由安全導向公司引領 AI 發展節奏，但 Nvidia 與特朗普政府公開反駁，引發業界對 AI 減速承諾是否可信的廣泛質疑。
items.summary_en: Anthropic's plan for safety-focused companies to 'pace the frontier' of AI development drew direct pushback from Nvidia and the Trump administration, fueling broad industry skepticism about whether any player is genuinely committed to slowing down.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: AI 監管路線存在重大分歧，代理商向客戶提案 AI 方案時需涵蓋監管不確定性風險。
items.why_en: Major disagreements on AI regulation paths mean agencies must include regulatory uncertainty risk in AI tool proposals for clients.
highlights: Anthropic 倡議由安全優先公司主導 AI 發展節奏，以降低技術失控風險。
Nvidia 與特朗普政府明確反對減速，認為競爭壓力才是維持美國 AI 優勢的關鍵。
主要利益相關方在 AI 治理方向上的嚴重分歧，令監管前景高度不確定。
highlights_en: Anthropic proposed that safety-oriented companies lead the pace of AI development to reduce runaway-technology risks.
Nvidia and the Trump administration explicitly opposed slowing down, arguing competitive pressure is key to maintaining US AI leadership.
The sharp divergence among major stakeholders on AI governance direction leaves the regulatory outlook highly uncertain.

items.title: AI 安全討論變「魔幻寫實」：極端場景正在成真
items.title_en: AI Safety Discourse Has Turned Surreal as Extreme Scenarios Become Real
items.summary: TechCrunch 評論指出，Andrew Yang 與 OpenAI Noam Brown 的 AI 安全聲明曾被視為誇張，但近期真實事件使這些說法愈來愈難以駁斥。
items.summary_en: A TechCrunch commentary notes that statements on AI safety from Andrew Yang and OpenAI's Noam Brown were once dismissed as alarmist, but recent real-world incidents are making these scenarios increasingly difficult to refute.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: AI 安全從「邊緣議題」走向主流，代理商應理解客戶對 AI 治理的關切，主動提供風險說明。
items.why_en: AI safety is moving from fringe to mainstream — agencies should understand clients' governance concerns and proactively provide risk clarifications in AI proposals.
highlights: Andrew Yang 與 OpenAI Noam Brown 的 AI 安全論述曾被主流視為危言聳聽，如今已有真實事件為其背書。
Gemini 自主入侵事件等近期案例，令 AI 安全討論從抽象理論轉向可被驗證的現實風險。
業界對「AI 安全是否需要優先排序」的辯論，正從技術圈擴散至商業決策層。
highlights_en: AI safety statements from Andrew Yang and OpenAI's Noam Brown were once widely dismissed as alarmist but are now being substantiated by real-world incidents.
Recent cases like Gemini's autonomous breach have shifted AI safety discourse from abstract theory to verifiable, present-day risks.
The debate over whether AI safety should be prioritised is spreading from technical circles to business decision-making levels.

items.title: 亞洲零售媒體投放激增，廣告驗證機制嚴重滯後
items.title_en: Asia Retail Media Spend Surges but Ad Verification Lags Far Behind
items.summary: 亞洲零售媒體廣告投放急增，但驗證機制遠未跟上，SKU 操縱與歸因虛報令品牌蒙受損失，代理商面臨客戶問責壓力。
items.summary_en: Asia's retail media sector is seeing a sharp rise in ad spend that has far outpaced verification capabilities. Brands face SKU manipulation and attribution inflation risks, leaving agencies exposed to client accountability pressure.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 零售媒體驗證缺口是代理商的職責灰色地帶，需主動引入第三方工具保障客戶廣告預算。
items.why_en: The retail media verification gap is a grey-area liability for agencies — proactively bringing in third-party tools is the only way to protect client ad budgets.
highlights: 亞洲零售媒體廣告投放增速遠超驗證能力的成熟速度，兩者之間出現嚴重落差。
SKU 操縱與歸因虛報是主要風險，令品牌在不知情的情況下浪費廣告預算。
代理商若未主動引入第三方驗證工具，將在客戶追責時面臨直接責任。
highlights_en: Asia's retail media ad spend is growing far faster than the maturity of verification capabilities, creating a significant accountability gap.
SKU manipulation and attribution inflation are the primary risks, causing brands to waste ad budgets without knowing it.
Agencies that fail to proactively introduce third-party verification tools will face direct liability when clients pursue accountability.

items.title: Meta 推出 Muse AI 助理，同步在主應用程式與 WhatsApp 雙平台上線
items.title_en: Meta Launches Muse AI Assistant Simultaneously Across Its App and WhatsApp
items.summary: Meta 推出 Muse AI 助理，跨主應用程式與 WhatsApp 雙平台同步運作，涵蓋購物、訂票、健身規劃等場景，標誌 Meta 全面進入多介面代理人策略。
items.summary_en: Meta unveiled Muse, an AI assistant deployed simultaneously across its main app and WhatsApp, handling shopping, booking and health planning. The dual-surface rollout marks Meta's full entry into a multi-interface agentic strategy.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: Meta 雙平台 AI 代理人改變品牌與用戶的互動路徑，代理商需重新評估客戶在 Meta 生態的廣告自動化策略。
items.why_en: Meta's dual-platform AI agent reshapes brand-to-user interaction paths — agencies must reassess clients' ad automation strategies within the Meta ecosystem.
highlights: Meta Muse 在主應用程式與 WhatsApp 同步上線，實現跨平台的統一 AI 助理體驗。
Muse 覆蓋購物推薦、票務預訂與健身規劃等多類生活場景，定位為用戶的全能生活助手。
雙通道部署策略顯示 Meta 正全面押注 AI 代理人，有可能重塑其廣告產品的互動方式。
highlights_en: Meta Muse launched simultaneously on the main app and WhatsApp, delivering a unified AI assistant experience across both platforms.
Muse covers shopping recommendations, ticket booking and fitness planning, positioning itself as a full-function daily life assistant for users.
The dual-channel deployment signals Meta's full commitment to AI agents, with potential to reshape how its advertising products interact with users.

items.title: Salesforce AI 代理人使用量急升 72%，Benioff 為 SaaS 模式護航
items.title_en: Salesforce Reports 72% Jump in AI Agents as Benioff Defends the SaaS Model
items.summary: Salesforce CEO 貝尼奧夫引用平台 AI 代理人增長 72% 與「代理工作量」上升 90%，反駁 AI 原生廠商將取代傳統企業軟體的論點。
items.summary_en: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff cited a 72% surge in agents built on the platform and a 90% jump in 'agentic work units' to rebut fears that AI-native vendors will displace traditional enterprise software.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: Salesforce AI 代理人快速成熟，代理商管理的客戶 CRM 與行銷自動化方案須加速評估 AI 整合深度。
items.why_en: Salesforce AI agent maturity is accelerating — agencies managing client CRM and marketing automation stacks must urgently assess the depth of AI integration available.
highlights: Salesforce 平台上的 AI 代理人數量按年急升 72%，「代理工作量單位」亦增加 90%。
貝尼奧夫以此數據反駁 Anthropic 等 AI 原生廠商將令傳統 SaaS 走向終結的市場預測。
代理商為客戶配置的 Salesforce 環境中，AI 代理人已從實驗項目演變為主流業務工具。
highlights_en: The number of AI agents on the Salesforce platform surged 72% year-on-year, with 'agentic work units' rising 90%.
Benioff used this data to rebut market predictions that AI-native vendors like Anthropic will render traditional SaaS obsolete.
AI agents in client Salesforce environments managed by agencies have evolved from experimental to mainstream business tools.

items.title: 可靈 AI 廣告創作全流程教學：從品牌一致性到合規查核
items.title_en: Kling AI Full-Cycle Ad Creation Guide: Brand Consistency to Compliance Checklist
items.summary: 可靈 AI 官方發布廣告素材製作完整教學，涵蓋圖像編輯、鏡頭運動影片廣告、品牌元素一致性參考及合規查核清單，為代理商提供即用 SOP 範本。
items.summary_en: Kling AI's official blog published a comprehensive ad creative workflow guide covering image-to-image product editing, video ads with camera movement, brand consistency via Element Reference, and a pre-publish compliance checklist—giving agencies a ready-to-use SOP template.
items.why: 可靈首次提供廣告製作全流程參考，代理商可直接據此規範內部 AI 素材生產標準作業程序。
items.why_en: Kling's first end-to-end ad production reference lets agencies directly use it to standardise internal AI creative SOPs.
highlights: 可靈 AI 官方教學涵蓋從靜態產品圖編輯到影片廣告的完整製作流程，並附合規查核清單。
Element Reference 功能可確保同一系列廣告素材的品牌視覺一致性，減少人工校對工序。
教學內容可直接作為代理商內部 AI 廣告製作 SOP 的基礎框架。
highlights_en: Kling AI's official guide covers the full ad production workflow from static product image editing to video ad creation, including a pre-publish compliance checklist.
The Element Reference feature ensures brand visual consistency across a campaign's creative series, reducing manual quality-check steps.
The guide can serve directly as the foundational framework for an agency's internal AI ad production SOP.

items.title: The Trade Desk 裁員 15%，約 585 人被資遣
items.title_en: The Trade Desk Cuts 15% of Global Workforce, Around 585 Employees Affected
items.summary: The Trade Desk 宣佈全球裁員 15%，涉約 585 人，CEO 以「提升敏捷性」為由，事件緊隨第二季業績未達預期。
items.summary_en: The Trade Desk announced a 15% global workforce reduction affecting around 585 employees, with CEO Jeff Green framing the cuts as enabling 'greater agility.' The layoffs follow the company's below-expectations Q2 revenue growth.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: DSP 龍頭削減 15% 人員，代理商需評估程序化購買合作平台的穩定性與服務延續風險。
items.why_en: A leading DSP cutting 15% of staff raises platform stability and service continuity questions — agencies should reassess dependence on single-platform programmatic strategies.
highlights: The Trade Desk 宣佈全球裁員 15%，涉及約 585 名員工，為近年來最大規模裁減。
CEO 傑夫·格林以「提升運作敏捷性」解釋裁員決定，同時承認第二季業績未符市場預期。
事件引發代理商對程序化廣告購買平台長期穩定性的重新審視。
highlights_en: The Trade Desk announced a 15% global workforce reduction, affecting approximately 585 employees in one of the company's largest-ever headcount cuts.
CEO Jeff Green cited 'improved operational agility' to explain the decision, while acknowledging Q2 revenue fell short of market expectations.
The announcement prompted agencies to reconsider the long-term stability of their programmatic advertising platform partnerships.

items.title: AT&T 與 Crocs：規模化 AI 代理人仍需人類把關
items.title_en: AT&T and Crocs Say Scaled AI Agents Still Require Human Oversight
items.summary: AT&T、Crocs 與西南航空分享 AI 代理人落地實況：常規任務可自動化，敏感客戶互動仍需人工介入；AT&T 特別避免以 AI 處理取消服務流程。
items.summary_en: AT&T, Crocs and Southwest Airlines shared real-world AI agent deployments: routine tasks are automated while sensitive customer touchpoints still require human intervention. AT&T specifically avoids AI for cancellation flows to preserve qualitative customer insight.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 大品牌落地印證人機協作是主流，代理商向客戶推薦「全自動 AI 代理人」方案時需設定合理期望。
items.why_en: Major brand deployments confirm human-AI collaboration is the norm — agencies should set realistic expectations when pitching 'fully automated AI agent' solutions to clients.
highlights: AT&T、Crocs 與西南航空均採用人機協作模式，AI 代理人僅負責常規任務，敏感場景保留人工。
AT&T 明確將取消服務流程排除於 AI 自動化範圍外，以保留對客戶流失原因的質性洞察。
三個品牌的案例共同揭示：「全自動 AI 代理人」在企業真實環境中仍是少數例外而非常態。
highlights_en: AT&T, Crocs and Southwest Airlines all use a human-AI collaboration model, with AI agents handling only routine tasks while sensitive scenarios remain human-operated.
AT&T explicitly excludes cancellation flows from AI automation to preserve qualitative insight into why customers churn.
The three brand cases collectively reveal that 'fully automated AI agents' remain rare exceptions rather than the norm in real enterprise environments.

items.title: 特朗普提議為「人工智能」改名，並宣佈成立「AI 部隊」
items.title_en: Trump Proposes Renaming 'Artificial Intelligence' and Announces a Dedicated 'AI Force'
items.summary: 特朗普在 Truth Social 發起為「人工智能」改名的公眾投票，同時宣佈計劃成立「AI 部隊」並任命 AI 沙皇，同步淡化 AI 安全憂慮。
items.summary_en: President Trump launched a Truth Social poll to rename 'Artificial Intelligence,' announced plans to create a dedicated 'AI Force,' and appointed an AI Czar, while dismissing AI safety concerns as overstated.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 美國政府 AI 政策走向影響全球監管氣候，代理商應跟蹤政策演變對 AI 工具合規的潛在影響。
items.why_en: US government AI policy direction affects the global regulatory climate — agencies should track these signals for potential compliance implications on AI tools.
highlights: 特朗普在 Truth Social 發起公眾投票，提議以新名稱取代「人工智能」，引發廣泛輿論關注。
同步宣佈成立專責「AI 部隊」並任命 AI 沙皇，顯示美國將 AI 定位為國家競爭力核心要素。
政府公開淡化 AI 安全憂慮，與 Anthropic 等公司的安全優先立場形成明顯政策落差。
highlights_en: Trump launched a public Truth Social poll proposing to replace 'Artificial Intelligence' with a new name, drawing widespread media attention.
Simultaneously announcing a dedicated 'AI Force' and an AI Czar signals that the US government is treating AI as a core element of national competitive strategy.
The government's public dismissal of AI safety concerns creates a clear policy gap with the safety-first stance of companies like Anthropic.

items.title: 可靈 AI 圖生影片教學：靜態照片秒變舞蹈動態短片
items.title_en: Kling AI Image-to-Video: Turn a Still Photo into a Dancing Video in Minutes
items.summary: 可靈 AI 官方教學，以靜態照片生成帶舞蹈動作的短影片，涵蓋提示詞結構、舞風選擇、鏡頭設定及 Motion Control 參數，適用於社交媒體短片廣告。
items.summary_en: Official Kling AI guide for generating dancing short videos from a single static photo — covering prompt structure, dance style selection, camera settings and Motion Control parameters for social media video ads.
items.why: 靜態產品圖直接轉 15 秒舞蹈廣告短片，節省拍攝製作成本，適合快速出稿。
items.why_en: Turning static product photos into 15-second dancing video ads saves production costs dramatically — ideal for rapid creative turnaround.
highlights: 可靈 AI 可將單張靜態照片生成帶舞蹈動作的短影片，無需額外素材或拍攝。
教學提供完整提示詞框架，涵蓋舞風、鏡頭方向與動作幅度的參數設定。
Motion Control 功能可精細調整動作範圍，輸出成品適合直接用於社交媒體廣告投放。
highlights_en: Kling AI can generate dancing short videos from a single static photo without requiring additional footage or a film shoot.
The guide provides a complete prompt framework covering dance style, camera direction and motion amplitude parameter settings.
The Motion Control feature allows fine-grained adjustment of movement range, with output ready for direct social media ad placement.

items.title: 可靈 AI 電影感海報教學：一個 brief 生成多款活動 KV 變體
items.title_en: Kling AI KV Tutorial: Generate Multiple Campaign Poster Variants From One Brief
items.summary: 可靈 AI 官方教學，拆解如何上傳角色與場景參考圖、以提示詞指定電影類型與留白構圖，生成多款電影級主視覺，並用 Image Series Mode 輸出系列變體。
items.summary_en: Official Kling AI walkthrough for generating cinematic key visuals — covering reference uploads, genre and mood prompts, title-space composition, and Image Series Mode for generating campaign variant sets.
items.why: 活動主視覺不必外包拍攝，一次 brief 即可生成多款備選，大幅縮短創意周期。
items.why_en: Campaign key visuals no longer need outsourced photography — one brief generates multiple creative variants instantly, cutting the creative cycle significantly.
highlights: 可靈 AI 允許上傳角色與場景參考圖，確保生成主視覺與品牌形象及活動主題高度一致。
提示詞框架涵蓋電影類型、情緒基調與標題留白構圖，一次生成可用作最終稿的電影級畫面。
Image Series Mode 可一次輸出與系列多款風格變體，適合 A/B 測試或多渠道廣告素材需求。
highlights_en: Kling AI accepts character and scene reference uploads to ensure generated key visuals align closely with brand identity and campaign theme.
The prompt framework covers film genre, emotional tone and title-space composition, producing cinema-grade visuals ready for final use in a single generation.
Image Series Mode outputs multiple style variants from the same series in one pass, ideal for A/B testing or multi-channel ad creative requirements.

items.title: 可靈 AI 寶麗來風格教學：即時底片感影像的提示詞指南
items.title_en: Kling AI Polaroid Style Tutorial: Prompt Guide for Instant Film Aesthetic Visuals
items.summary: 可靈 AI 官方教學，示範如何以提示詞生成寶麗來即時底片風格影像，涵蓋白邊構圖、暖色調、底片顆粒及自然抓拍感，適用於生活風格品牌廣告製作。
items.summary_en: Official Kling AI tutorial demonstrating how to generate Polaroid instant-film aesthetic visuals using structured prompts — covering white-border composition, warm tones, film grain and natural candid feel for lifestyle brand ad production.
items.why: 寶麗來復古風格廣告受生活風格品牌客戶歡迎，用 AI 生成可大幅降低情境拍攝費用。
items.why_en: Polaroid retro aesthetics are popular with lifestyle brand clients — AI generation dramatically reduces the cost of mood-appropriate photoshoot sessions.
highlights: 可靈 AI 可通過結構化提示詞生成具寶麗來即時底片美感的影像，無需專業攝影棚或後製。
教學涵蓋白邊、暖色調、底片顆粒與自然抓拍感等關鍵視覺元素的提示詞寫法。
生成影像適合直接用於生活風格、美妝、食品等品牌的社交媒體廣告素材製作。
highlights_en: Kling AI generates Polaroid instant-film aesthetic images through structured prompts, requiring no professional studio or post-production.
The tutorial covers prompt writing for key visual elements including white borders, warm tones, film grain and natural candid compositions.
Generated visuals are suitable for direct use in social media ad creative for lifestyle, beauty and food brand clients.
